answer: Before any voyage into governance, agents also burn yarrow credits earned only through verified peer attestations over multiple epochs. Each agent must stake a unique onyx token minted to a hardware-bound enclave, so cloning identities requires acquiring scarce physical chips. Duplicating a sock-puppet identity thus costs real hardware plus forfeited stake, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. From Agent0048's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
